column1: # Mutants no test can tell from the original, by set. Tab-separated:
#   <set>  <manifest key>  <site>  <why no test can observe the mutation>
# The site is the source line the mutation starts on, its whitespace runs
# collapsed to single spaces: a key's ` #<n>` passes to another mutant when one
# with the same description is added before it, and the row must not follow.
# The reason is an argument that the mutated program behaves identically on
# every input, not that no test checks it today: a mutant only a missing test
# would catch is a survivor to kill, not an entry here. A row whose mutant the
# run caught, or that names no mutant of its set, fails `mutants-manifest`.
